rationale: The mission is well-defined and bounded: fix a retry bug in RetryFetcher where retrying transient failures incorrectly triggers duplicate in-flight detection. Baseline test failures confirm an existing issue that needs resolution without altering the public API or adding dependencies.
concerns: Ensure in-flight request tracking is cleared or properly recognized across retry attempts so legitimate concurrent calls still detect duplicates if intended by design.

goals: Fix retry handling in RetryFetcher so transient failures retry without tripping duplicate in-flight detection.
Preserve maxRetries semantics and existing public API.
Ensure all tests pass cleanly without introducing external dependencies.
requirements: Do not add new dependencies to package.json.
Do not change public API signatures or contract.
Retries must succeed on transient failure recovery without duplicate in-flight errors.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run test passes with exit code 0.
Duplicate in-flight detection works for actual concurrent requests while allowing sequential retry attempts for the same operation.
No unrelated files or configurations are modified.

plan.description: Inspect test suite output and RetryFetcher implementation to locate duplicate in-flight detection and retry logic.
Fix in-flight tracking state transition during retry execution.
Run npm run test to verify fix and ensure no regressions.
